claims: The Minnesota Wild play the Dallas Stars in Game 2 of the 2026 Stanley Cup Playoffs first round on April 20, 2026.
Minnesota Wild won Game 1 6-1 against Dallas Stars.
Minnesota Wild lead Dallas Stars 1-0 in the series.
Game 2 of the Minnesota Wild vs. Dallas Stars series is at 4:30 pm CT.
Game 2 of the Minnesota Wild vs. Dallas Stars series is broadcast on ESPN.
The venue for Game 2 of the Minnesota Wild vs. Dallas Stars series is American Airlines Center, Dallas.
Mats Zuccarello is out with an upper-body injury.
Vladimir Tarasenko will take Mats Zuccarello's spot.
Jesper Wallstedt saved 27-of-28 shots in Game 1.
Joel Eriksson Ek scored in Game 1.
